text: Chapter 12: The Weredragons' Vital Point@Rivalry Between Dragons and Weredragons
■Next Mission\nMove from Draco Town to\nNebula Plain to start.
Head to Boma Moja, the village of the weredragons, while\navoiding the trap holes all over the ground and fighting\nthe monsters that live in the vicinity!
The dragon that appeared suddenly is destroying the village\nand seems to be holding some weredragons hostage in the\ncenter of the village. Head there to free the hostages!
You were able to rescue the hostages with the help of a\nmysterious Knight of Thorns who appeared out of nowhere.\nNow, without further ado, finish Burning Dragon Igneus!
